root_cause.runtime_behavior: _fuse_delta_o_output calls _add_delta_o_to_reference for attention_output placement; memory_fusion_residual_scale is used only by post-attention norm-hook placements.
root_cause.interpretation: All configured scales were present on all 42 modules but were behaviorally inert. This study does not test the scientific strength-calibration hypothesis and must not be interpreted as evidence that amplitude is irrelevant.

analysis_incident.initial_behavior: The analyzer wrote the valid failing result, then raised because a declared selection-output path was present even though no selection file was written.
analysis_incident.resolution: Withhold selection silently on fit failure and return exit code 2; add regression coverage for the inert attention_output scale path.

next_direction.immediate: Repeat strength calibration with the existing eval-only memory-delta controller, multiplying every Q/O raw memory delta before fusion. Bind the controller implementation and output-change smoke before the full run.
next_direction.fallback: If effective Q/O scaling fails held-out materiality, train with negative-state contrast and state dropout.
